name: Operation
description: Represents an operation defined for an Entity object.
remarks: Use the WSParameters property to return the parameters defined for the specified operation. Use the Execute method to execute the operation.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Use the Name property to specify or determine the string expression that identifies the name of an object. Read/write String.

properties.name: WSParameters
properties.description: Gets the collection of parameters defined for the specified operation. Read-only WSParameters.

parameters.name: bstrParameters
parameters.description: Specifies values for the parameters of the operation.
